<<Notes on Cleaning A Telescope Mirror>>  
Regular cleaning of telescope mirrors is essential for optimal performance. Use a soft, lint-free cloth to wipe the surface gently. Avoid abrasive materials that may scratch the mirror. For stubborn dirt, a mild detergent solution can be used, but rinse thoroughly and dry immediately. Ensure the mirror is clean and clear to enjoy the best view of celestial objects. Clean mirrors regularly to maintain clarity and enhance your observing experience.
